pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with soft edge gradients. The shapes are predominantly four-to-six sided with rounded vertices, exhibiting higher spatial density on the mid-flank and increasing in relative area towards the neck base.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-pigmented pathways. Intersections primarily consist of three-way (Y-junction) and four-way nodes. The pixel thickness of the corridors is relatively wide and uniform throughout the visible flank area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, dark vertical linear feature is visible on the mid-flank, appearing as a sharp textural disruption or deep skin fold/scar.
